description: Retrieves a list of organizations available to the authenticated session. Use this action when you need to discover which organizations the user has access to before performing operations on a specific organization. This is essential for organization-bound operations that require an organization_id_or_slug parameter. Note that API key requests only return the associated organization.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for listing organizations available to the authenticated user.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to retrieve the next or previous results. Use the cursor value from the Link header of a previous response.
cursor.title: Cursor

owner.description: Specify true to restrict results to organizations in which you are an owner. When false or omitted, returns all organizations you have access to.
owner.title: Owner

query.description: Search query to filter organizations. Supports filtering by id, slug, status, email, member_id, and query fields.
query.title: Query

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by in descending order. Valid values: 'members' (sort by member count) or 'events' (sort by event count).
sortBy.title: Sort By
